text.p: The following are leading domestic stories in Portuguese newspapers.
- Palestinian President Yasser Arafat could visit the OSCE summit on Lisbon next Monday for a meeting with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu.
- Portugal's post office is seeking a strategic partner in the banking system.
- AutoEuropa car manufacturer plans to reduce its production by 10 percent in the first quarter of 1997, the newspaper learned.

- The biggest foreign investment in Portugal, AutoEuropa, a joint-venture between Ford and Volkswagen, halts production on Friday because it had problems getting supplies through due to the French truckers' strike.
- Steel products company SN SGPS posted a loss of 8.6 billion escudos in 1995.
- Banco Portugues de Investimento is concluding a capital increase for 135 billion escudos carried out over the past 12 months.
